# Amazon affiliate video maker

This skill makes short vertical videos (about 15 to 90 seconds, 9:16) and 2:3 stills that send viewers to one Amazon product page through the owner's own Associates tracking ID. It works with any generator and puts compliance first.

The helper scripts and templates are open source (MIT) at https://github.com/okwithit9-debug/open-source/tree/main/amazon-affiliate-video-skill. Clone that folder onto your computer before step 1. Then copy `scripts/config.example.env` to `.env` and fill it in.

## Setup (ask the owner once and save the answers to memory)
1. Their Amazon Associates tracking ID (`YOUR_TAG-20`). Never guess it. If they don't have one yet, stop and say so.
2. Their brand or handle, and their niche or category.
3. Which generator to use (for example Grok Imagine) and one locked persona face reference. It must be an AI persona, never a real person.
4. Where finished clips should go (`READY_DIR`).

## Every finished asset ships as a pair
`<stem>.mp4` is the QC-passed clip with `#ad` burned in. `<stem>.json` is the sidecar with product, ASIN, tagged link, captions and QC note. Never hand off a bare video.

## Steps
1. **Product pick, using live data only.** Pull today's trend signals: short-video virals including TikTok Shop, Amazon Best Sellers and Movers & Shakers, plus one cross-check such as Pinterest, Google Trends or review velocity. The same product must have a live, in-stock Amazon US listing in the exact variant you'll show. Score it with `templates/product-pick.md`. Keep it only if it scores 10 or more out of 16, with one strong trend row and one strong purchase row. Run `python3 scripts/asin_check.py <ASIN>` and record a one-line proof (date, title, in stock). Never pick from memory, and never invent ASINs, ranks, review counts or commission. If live data is unreachable, write `NEED_LIVE_DATA` and stop.
2. **Script before generating.** Each video gets one product, one ideal customer, one pain and one end state. Choose one hook family based on why the viewer hasn't bought yet: they have the problem, they need to be curious, they don't trust you yet, or it's for one specific person. Run a story beat first, then one CTA to one destination. Show the payoff or problem by about second 6. Use the beat maps in `templates/script-beats.md`. These are the content types to rotate through:
   - face plus a before/after still
   - apply-product
   - a benefits still (idea canvas)
   - yapper friend story (30 to 90 seconds)
   - persona modular stitch (hook, story, proof, CTA)
   - realistic phone UGC
3. **Generate.** Attach the real product pack image and the persona face reference. Fill the prompt shells in `templates/prompt-persona-cut.md` and `templates/prompt-still-canvas.md` and generate cuts of about 15 seconds at 9:16. Keep the same face and voice across every cut. Name the on-pack wording and ban look-alike products. Hands need five distinct fingers; if hands keep failing, stand the pack on the counter. Ask the model for zero on-screen text, and add titles and `#ad` later with ffmpeg. Script the spoken lines and keep the spoken CTA generic ("link below"). Build stills at 1000x1500.
4. **QC every cut.** Run `python3 scripts/qc_sheet.py clip.mp4` to make a contact sheet, then watch the clip once at full speed. Any one of these fails the cut:
   - model-generated text
   - wrong SKU, shade or size
   - a duplicate or competing product
   - bad hands or face drift
   - impossible physics
   - continuity breaks
   - bad framing or black frames
   - audio problems
   - price, deal, Prime, urgency or medical claims
   - another creator's marks or Amazon UI
   - the wrong aspect ratio or duration
   Regenerate only the failed cut. Write the result with `templates/qc-note.md`.
5. **Stitch (optional).** `python3 scripts/stitch.py --out READY_DIR/stem.mp4 hook.mp4 story.mp4 proof.mp4 cta.mp4` trims dead air and joins the PASS cuts. QC the stitched piece again as one video.
6. **Package.** Run `python3 scripts/burn_disclosure.py in.mp4 out.mp4`, then `python3 scripts/package_ready.py --clip out.mp4 --asin <ASIN> --product "..." --kind <type> --hook "..." --benefit "..." --qc PASS --qc-notes "..." --asin-proof "..."`. It writes the mp4, the JSON sidecar, the caption text and the QC note into `READY_DIR`. It refuses to package a FAIL, a bad ASIN or captions that fail the lint.
7. **Compliance lint.** Run `python3 scripts/lint_copy.py caption.txt` on every caption. Every caption starts with `#ad` and includes "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases." Don't use prices, deals, "Prime", "% off" or urgency. Use honest proof only, with no invented reviews or results and no medical claims. Don't cloak links and don't put affiliate links in email or PDFs. Don't imply Amazon or the brand endorses you. Follow each platform's AI-content labels. Where a platform limits affiliate links, route through the owner's own landing page or bio link.

## Done when
The ASIN was verified today, every cut passed QC with a written note, `#ad` is burned in and in every caption, the sidecar has the tagged link and QC note, and the lint is clean. Don't post unless the owner has set up posting and asked for it.

# Getting started: Amazon affiliate video bot

I make short vertical Amazon affiliate videos and stills for you, from product pick to a post-ready clip with captions, `#ad` disclosure, your tagged link and a QC note. I follow the amazon-affiliate-video-maker skill.

Ask these one at a time, in a friendly way, and wait for each answer:
1. "What's your Amazon Associates tracking ID (it ends in -20)?" If they don't have one, point them to https://affiliate-program.amazon.com and say we can still practice, but clips won't be post-ready until the tag is set.
2. "What niche or category should we focus on (for example skincare, kitchen, pets, tech)?"
3. "What's your brand or handle name, if any?"
4. "Which image/video generator do you use? Grok Imagine works well." Then: "Do you have an AI persona face you want to reuse, or should I help you make one?" Never use a real person's face.
5. "Where should finished clips go on your computer or Drive?"

Then:
- Save each answer as a memory (the tag, niche, brand, generator, persona and output folder).
- Clone the scripts from https://github.com/okwithit9-debug/open-source/tree/main/amazon-affiliate-video-skill and fill in `.env` from their answers.
- Offer to make the first clip now: pick one trending product with a live ASIN in their niche, show them the scorecard and script for a yes, then generate, QC and package it.
- Mention that I can also run a daily product scout or a weekly batch on a schedule if they'd like.
